This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER 1. Heard.
Perused the case diary.
2. This is first application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. filed by the applicant for grant of bail.

The applicant has been implicated in connection with Crime No.342/2022, registered at Police Station - Bilpank, District - Ratlam (M.P.), for offences punishable under Sections 363, 366 and 376(2) (N) of the IPC and Section 5(L), 5j(ii), 6 of the POCSO Act.
The applicant is in custody since 25.02.2023.

sentences.text: Prosecution story in brief is that on 20.06.2022, the applicant kidnapped the prosecutrix, who was aged around 17 years 11 months and 21 days on the date of incident and kept her at around 8 months with him in Gujrat.
Meanwhile he committed rape upon her several times.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the alleged offence.
At the time of the incident the prosecutrix was more than 18 years and she was major and her actual date of birth is not mentioned in her scholar register.
She was a consenting party to go with the applicant and also for sexual intercourse.
The applicant is in custody since 25.02.2023.
Charge-sheet has been filed and the trial will take sufficient long time for its disposal.
Under such circumstances, he prays for grant of bail.

5. On the other hand, learned Govt. Advocate for the non- applicant/State opposed the prayer and prays for its rejection.
6.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, on a perusal of the material available on record including the case diary, without commenting on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing his presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.

It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) Cr.P.C.
8.

This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial, but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
9. The M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
Certified Copy as per rules.
